meta.title: Try to purchase a BOQ-based PR with a material PR

plan.title: Block mixed BOQ and material PR purchase

steps.note: Enable BOQ-based PR sourcing as required by the case.

args.goal: Select one BOQ-based PR together with one material PR, hover Purchase Items to reveal its disabled reason, and try clicking Purchase Items; stop on the PR list showing the control disabled and no purchase flow opened.

steps.note: The catalog has no step for selecting two different PRs, so perform the mixed selection and refused click directly on the buyer screen.
Assert that the mixed BOQ/material selection leaves Purchase Items disabled.

args.text: BOQ-based PR cannot pe purchased along with Material PR

steps.note: Verify the app's exact disabled-control explanation, including its displayed spelling.
